about: The collision audit's CI limits, islands mode on today's wild island (v1: the `wildIsland: "v1"` setting, the rollback path, decision 272: scripts/ark-collide-audit.mts --fixture --wild-island kept --world v1 --hours 2 --step 4; 5,328 animals, 4,267 measured), measured on ark-next 11901a6a (2026-11-13), the same as GitHub run 43275537669's islands numbers there. Pass-throughs and fence crossings stay at 0; cliffs (210) and overlaps (3,164,272: mostly perched and sleeping animals sharing crowns, held where they rest) at most today's. These are the limits thresholds-islands.json held for v1 until v2 became islands mode's island (W1), plus W1's shared behaviour changes (+38 overlap samples). A change that makes them worse fails the PR; a deliberate change updates them here, with why. Then on ark-flight-physics (lane MA1, movement audit problems 1 and 3): birds fly at their cruise and take off and land at half a g, walk, wade or swim a way too short for a flight to be worth it, and fly for its own sake somewhere worth flying to (clear of their predators, in the open), so more birds stand and walk among the others for shorter flights: overlaps 3,164,272 to 3,178,078 (+0.44%); pass-throughs, fence crossings and cliffs unchanged. Then pass 3 (ark-p3-merge 270da51e, 2026-11-17, GitHub run of ark-collisions on that commit): shrubs on both islands became solid to bodies wider than their stems' gaps (the owner: "I just saw a horse go through a bush"; lane ark-p3-solid), so animals that stood inside bushes now stand beside them and beside each other: overlaps 3,178,078 to 3,248,236 (+2.2%) on this rollback island only (v2, what goes live, stays within its limit); pass-throughs and fence crossings 0, cliffs 192 (down). Then p5 (monkeys, ark-p5-monkeys, GitHub run 44050565509): tree climbers climb the trunk instead of a straight line through the air from the ground to the limb (the owner: "monkeys are climbing trees parallel to the ground and not the tree"), so a climb now walks to the trunk foot on the ground first and goes tree to tree down, across the ground and up: overlaps 3,248,236 to 3,248,323 (+87 samples, +0.003%) on this rollback island only (v2, what goes live, stays within its limit); pass-throughs and fence crossings 0, cliffs 192.
